text: `_distill_update(capsule_id, changed_files, status='success')` returns a capsule-update dictionary containing `id`, `status`, `goal`, `scope`, `constraints`, `oracles`, `claims`, `decision`, `lineage`, `errors`, `receipts`, and `changed_files`; in the visible implementation the oracle command is `null` and lineage uses `parent_capsule_ids: []`.
